roads.name: Wupatki and Sunset Crater loop road
words: Sweeping and steady: 39 curves in 10.1 miles.
From 5,828 to 7,086 ft, with 1,831 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 85°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.14 g.

roads.name: Snow Bowl Road
words: Properly twisty: 11 curves in 2.1 miles, about 5 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 8,590 to 9,306 ft, with 710 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 75°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.44 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: North Snow Bowl Road
words: Properly twisty: 23 curves in 2.6 miles, about 9 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 7,716 to 8,603 ft, with 894 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 79°F.

roads.name: Prescott–Flagstaff Highway
words: Properly twisty: 41 curves in 7.6 miles, about 5 a mile.
The 5 miles at the south end are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 5,094 to 6,433 ft, with 2,355 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
19 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 89°F.
